overview.summary: Roche remains the world's largest biotech by revenue, anchored on oncology (Tecentriq, Polivy, Phesgo), ophthalmology (Vabysmo), neuroscience (Ocrevus), and diagnostics. Their 2025-2026 strategy centers on replacing legacy biosimilar-exposed revenue (Herceptin/Avastin/Rituxan cliff absorbed) with new launches. Derm is minimal — limited to some oncology-adjacent skin cancers and early immunology exploration.
keyStrengths: Integrated pharma + diagnostics model (companion diagnostics, personalized medicine)
Deep antibody engineering capabilities (bispecifics, ADCs, recycling antibodies)
overview.threatRationale: Roche has minimal overlap with Almirall's core AD/PSO dermatology space. Their focus is oncology, ophthalmology, and neuroscience. The only derm-adjacent areas are some early immunology programs and skin cancer assets. Not a competitive threat to Ebglyss or Ilumetri in the foreseeable future.
